set.body:
Goal
Represent partial replay explicitly without allowing low transported mass or a coarse grid to erase chronology or cherry-pick convenient fixation pairs.

Implementation
Optimize or integrate explicit coverage M and unit-mass Gamma. Retain source/target selection through dominated marginals or separate divergences D(M alpha || a) and D(M beta || b). Use correspondence mutual information only as a smoothing regularizer. Replace an arbitrary normalized coverage grid with fixed-mass quadrature under a declared prior.

Acceptance criteria
- Coverage support includes coherent replay below 50 percent, with at least one node near 0.20-0.25.
- M = 0 is handled without division or log singularities; one- and two-fixation paths remain defined.
- Refining the coverage grid leaves fixture energies within 1e-3 and calibrated candidate information within 0.01 bits, or a stricter threshold frozen in GW-18.1.
- Splitting a fixation into colocated proportional atoms does not materially change coverage, selected mass, or score.
- The model cannot attain an attractive score by selecting one convenient pair without paying the declared source and target selection cost.
- Outputs distinguish matched coverage, selected encoding mass, selected recall mass, conditional spatial error, and conditional chronology error.
- Hyperparameters or coverage priors are estimated only inside inner folds or fixed prospectively.
set.title: GW-18.4 Make coverage and selection evidence refinement-invariant
